name: M7.Selection.finite_extreme
statement: ∀ (α : Type) (T : Finset α) (R : α → α → Prop), (∀ x, ¬ R x x) → (∀ x y z, R x y → R y z → R x z) → ∀ x ∈ T, ∃ y ∈ T, (∀ z ∈ T, ¬ R z y) ∧ (y = x ∨ R y x)
guidance: Use finite well-foundedness on subtype T: Mathlib Finite.wellFounded_of_trans_of_irrefl (Data/Fintype/Card) with local IsTrans and Std.Irrefl instances. Well-founded induction on the chosen point: if it has an improving predecessor, recurse and compose transitivity; otherwise it is an extreme. Alternatively finite set induction. Only the finite relation is assumed, not an oracle witness. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact statement and default limits.
